name: Fasil Ghebbi, Gondar Region
description: Fasil Ghebbi is a walled royal compound in the city of Gondar, in northern Ethiopia, where emperors ruled from the 1600s. Inside a wall of roughly 900 metres stand stone castles, a library, banqueting hall, stables and churches. Their styles blend Arab, Hindu and Portuguese-Jesuit Baroque touches, making it look unlike anywhere else in Africa.
